name: Eastern Media International Corporation
summary: Eastern Media International Corporation, a Taiwanese enterprise operating with its various subsidiaries, specializes in the logistics and storage of grains, providing services such as loading, unloading, and silo storage across both Taiwan and mainland China. The company's diverse business model is structured around four primary segments: Warehousing, Trading, Media, and Tourism. The Warehousing division is dedicated to general cargo storage. Its Trading arm oversees retail operations. The Media segment is involved in channel agency and advertising ventures. Lastly, the Tourism sector manages hotel properties and catering services. Beyond these core areas, Eastern Media also extends its offerings to the pet market, supplying pet foods and accessories, as well as providing pet grooming services. Its comprehensive portfolio additionally encompasses investment management, leisure facility administration, a broader range of catering provisions, real estate rental and leasing, video advertising solutions, audiovisual and performing arts activities, and the operation of amusement parks. The company also engages in the wholesale distribution of various goods, including cosmetics, jewelry, and household products. Furthermore, it offers management consulting, support services, and conducts market research and public opinion polls. Established in 1975 and headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, the corporation was originally named ET Internet Technology Corporation before officially adopting Eastern Media International Corporation in 2005.
